name: Caissa Tourism Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Caissa Tourism Group Co., Ltd. engages in outbound tourism, and air and rail catering industries in China and internationally. The company operates through Tourism Business; Catering and Food & Beverage Business; and Marine Cultural Tourism Business segments. It offers outbound and domestic travel, and inbound tourism, as well as group tours, customized tours, and cruise tourism services; and travel, exhibition reception, business visits, business transportation, and tour guides solutions, as well as meetings, incentives, conferences, and exhibitions.
